whatToWatch.text: Two straight losses, 3-3, and the Chiefs in town — this is the week the season tilts one way or the other, and Seattle gets to do it at home as a 3-point favorite.

The pass rush is the great equalizer: Seattle's getting to the quarterback 2.7 times a game versus KC's 1.6, and with Chiefs tackle Jaylon Moore among their four players ruled out, there's blood in the water up front.

A 42.5 total says everyone expects a knife fight — KC is allowing just 16.6 points a game, Seattle 20.3 — so with Nick Emmanwori, Uchenna Nwosu and Chazz Surratt headlining the Seahawks' injury report, every possession and every stop is going to feel enormous.

newsBlurb.text: Seattle's backfield arrives at Lumen Field held together with tape: Jadarian Price remains parked on injured reserve, leaving Zach Charbonnet's availability as the week's biggest question mark against Kansas City. Mike Macdonald offered nothing on Charbonnet's progress, so the Seahawks may have to manufacture a run game against the Chiefs with whoever's standing. Few storylines carry more weight Sunday than who lines up behind center in the backfield.
